\caption{Mean patch length in bytes ($\pm$ standard deviation over patches) on the exact byte sequences each evaluation scores (context followed by the gold answer; BOS excluded). Because patches tile the input, the mean patch length equals the compression ratio, i.e.\ the number of input bytes per position of the global model; for the subword Transformer the unit is a Llama-3 token. Patches come from each model's own parser: Llama-3 BPE tokens, AUNet's whitespace/word regex, BPEByte's OnlineBPE, BLT's entropy patcher at its released threshold ($1.335$), and H-Net's learned router (1-stage XL). Robustness rows pool the five tasks of Table~\ref{tab:main_13b} (Noise: $15$ variants and Typo: $8$ variants, first $400$ items each; Despace: all spaces removed, up to $2{,}000$ items; Clean: the unperturbed items). $^{\dagger}$BLT and $^{\ddagger}$H-Net are external references.}
